instruction: Set the power settings to 'Nothing' for automatic suspend when the computer is connected to power.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling automatic suspend when plugged in (AC power) in GNOME power settings. The evaluator checks if 'gsettings get org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.power sleep-inactive-ac-type' returns "'nothing'" (disabled). This uses existing evaluator functions (exact_match metric and vm_command_line getter) - no custom functions needed.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary scoring: 1.0 if sleep-inactive-ac-type is set to 'nothing', 0.0 otherwise
